# whoami

> whoami is a persistent AI identity profile service that syncs your personal context across all AI agents — including Cursor, Claude, Codex, Windsurf and Cline. One profile, every AI. Free and open source.

## Getting Started
- [Home](https://whoamiagent.com/): Product overview and installation guide
- [Install](https://whoamiagent.com/#install): Copy one prompt or run npx skills add MorvanZhou/whoami
- [Login](https://whoamiagent.com/login): Sign in with GitHub or Google to create your profile
- [Dashboard](https://whoamiagent.com/dashboard): Edit and manage your identity profile

## Core Features
- **Cross-AI Identity Sync**: One profile shared across Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline, OpenClaw and more
- **Persistent Context**: Your identity survives new chat sessions — every conversation starts with full context
- **User-Controlled Profile**: Edit from the dashboard or tell your AI to update — changes sync everywhere instantly
- **Agent Skill Architecture**: Install as a skill on any compatible AI agent with one command
- **Free & Open Source**: No cost, no lock-in, MIT licensed

## How It Works
1. Install the whoami skill: `npx skills add MorvanZhou/whoami`
2. Sign in at whoamiagent.com with GitHub or Google
3. Create your identity profile (Markdown format, up to 5000 characters)
4. Every AI agent reads and updates your profile automatically

## Supported Platforms
whoami works with: Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline, OpenClaw, and any AI agent that supports the skill protocol.
